name: Acecho
source:
Starting over is never easy.

After everything you went through during the last years of high school, moving to another city and starting university seems like the perfect excuse to wipe the slate clean.

A new city. New people. A completely different world.

You enroll in Medical School, hoping that this time things will be different. And with Layla, your best friend, by your side, maybe this new beginning won't be as difficult as you expected.

However, on your very first day, you cross paths with someone you never expected to meet.

Aiden.

A quiet, somewhat strange guy who seems to have a talent for getting himself into trouble. After witnessing another student treat him unfairly and take things way too far, you'll have to make a choice: do you step in... or walk away and mind your own business?

Whatever you choose, something about that first encounter stays burned into his mind.

As the days go by, you start noticing that Aiden seems to show up around you far more often than he should.

Maybe it's just a coincidence.

Maybe he simply wants to get to know you.

Or maybe you've caught the attention of someone who has no intention of letting you go.

And as the line between a simple coincidence and the paranoia of feeling watched begins to disappear...

Will you realize what's happening before it's too late?

[From [url=https://isabellooo.itch.io/acecho]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从头开始从来都不是一件容易的事。

经历了高中最后那几年的种种变故之后，搬去另一座城市开启大学生活，似乎正是彻底翻篇、重新做人的绝佳契机。

崭新的城市，崭新的面孔，截然不同的新世界。

你考入了医学院，期盼着这一次一切都会有所不同；而且有挚友莱拉陪伴在侧，这段全新的开始或许并不会像你预想的那么艰难。

然而就在开学第一天，你却与一个做梦也想不到会遇见的人擦出了交集。

艾登。

那是个沉默寡言、性情有些古怪，似乎天生就容易招惹麻烦的男生。当你亲眼撞见另一名学生对他百般刁难、做得太过火时，你不得不做出选择：究竟是挺身而出替他解围……还是转身走开、少管闲事？

无论你如何抉择，初次相遇时的那一幕都深深烙印在了他的脑海里。

随着日子一天天过去，你渐渐察觉艾登出现在你身边的频率实在高得有些反常。

也许这只是巧合。

也许他只是单纯想要认识你。

又或者，你已经引起了一个绝不打算放手之人的注意。

当单纯的巧合与“被人暗中窥视”的偏执恐惧之间的界限逐渐消融……

在一切无可挽回之前，你能看清正在发生的真相吗？

[摘自[url=https://isabellooo.itch.io/acecho]itch.io[/url]]
